title: validated.json
description: Phase 2 Validate output: research.json with verification overlays. Produced by validate skill. Consumed by map-generate-controls and generate-* skills. Adds verification_status/verification_note per item and botocore_enrichment metadata. Must carry existing_mitigations (CHECK-S13 requirement) which map-assemble.py reads.

scp_expressible.description: Mirrored from capabilities.organization_policies.scp_expressible by the validate skill so downstream skills (map, generate) can read it from the root.

rcp_expressible.description: Mirrored from capabilities.organization_policies.rcp_expressible by the validate skill so downstream skills (map, generate) can read it from the root.

attack_surface.description: Threat-attack-surface block populated by research-attack-surface and propagated through validate. Carries applicable_techniques, stride_to_attack_bridge, tactic_coverage_summary, customer_stride_profile, attack_surface_gaps, and the verified/unverified technique counts.

unverified_count.description: Number of items the validate skill could not confirm against MCP-backed sources.

unverified_items.description: Per-item details for the unverified count above.

enrichment_opportunities.description: Optional enrichment opportunities surfaced during validation.
